alt.text: A hiking guide leads a smiling family across a supported rope bridge over a rocky mountain stream while a safety worker stands nearby, turning a dangerous crossing into a safe one.

anatomy.notes: Five hikers and one safety worker have coherent proportions and limbs with no conspicuous malformed anatomy.

bridge_rope_support_physics.notes: The plank bridge, vertical posts, hand ropes, lower support members, anchors, and rocky ravine are spatially coherent and communicate real support.

meaning.notes: A guide, family group, and safety worker are shown safely traversing a dangerous mountain rope bridge; the scene communicates turning danger into safety.

perspective.notes: Bridge rails and planks recede consistently toward the mountain path; depth is clear.

pose_contact.notes: Feet contact the bridge planks and hands visibly hold or brace against the side ropes/railings.

readable_text_brand_watermark.notes: No unwanted text, logo, brand mark, or watermark is visible.

style.notes: Consistent bright watercolor storybook illustration style with clear focal action.
